two_algebra_roles: Gamma1..Gamma4 are space/time gravity Cl(3,1) vector generators, NOT the earlier 4x4 gamma matrices literally.
GammaPrime1..GammaPrime4 are four orthonormal electroweak Cl(4) vector generators, NOT the earlier 4x4 gamma-prime coefficients literally.
All eight source 16x16 generators are ordered outer-to-inner Kronecker products; do not permute tensor factors.
gamma_source.source_narrow_math: Clifford anticommutator Gamma_I Gamma_J+Gamma_J Gamma_I=2 eta_IJ I16; source's source-specific ordinary complex matrix realization only.
gamma_source.positive_chirality_orientation: source uses the first 8x8 quadrant of 16x16 chiral representation for source 8_S+; first outer Pauli factor yields chirality parity in this chosen source basis, no cross-track spinor equivalence
gamma_source.source_bivector: Gamma_{I J}=(1/2)[Gamma_I,Gamma_J], including gravity/electroweak and mixed ordered pairs; source H1 chiral even connection only.

H1.gravity_connection: omega=(1/2)*sum_{mu,nu=1}^4 omega^{mu nu}*Gamma_{mu nu}, sum over antisymmetric 4D source bivector indices
H1.electroweak_connection: w_ew=(1/2)*sum_{mu,nu=1}^4 w_ew^{mu nu}*GammaPrime_{mu nu}, with distinct independent w/B1 U/V source coefficient roles
H1.frame: e=sum_{mu=1}^4 e^mu*Gamma_mu, gravity 1-form with four frame component roles
H1.higgs: phi=sum_{nu=1}^4 phi^nu*GammaPrime_nu, four REAL scalar source coefficients, not a second independent 1-form
H1.mixed_operator: e*phi=sum_mu sum_nu e^mu*phi^nu*(Gamma_mu*GammaPrime_nu), ordered first gravity vector then electroweak vector; never reassociate with external operators
H1.mixed_source_role: e phi is a GRAVITY/ELECTROWEAK mixed Clifford bivector-valued ONE-FORM; gamma grav and gamma-prime EW anticommute; no scalar contraction between independent carriers
H1.source_modality: Source says fractions are necessary for fitting fields together and obtaining correct curvature dynamics. This is an AUTHOR CLAIM, not proved by the matrix Clifford check.
H1.full_8x8_display: Source displays positive-chiral 8x8 action on 8_S+ using four-by-four block of two-by-two Weyl/frame entries; exact individual connection matrix entries require separate source-native binder/field one-form cold transcription.
